title: Robustness of Valley-Hall Interface Modes Against Sharp Bending
summary: It is well known that band inversion across a straight interface in a periodic medium gives rise to interface modes that are localized near the interface and propagate along it inside the bulk spectral gap. This phenomenon constitutes the key mechanism underlying the valley-Hall effect. In this paper, we address the long-standing problem of the robustness of such interface modes.
